visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a sterile indoor medical clinic with bright, even studio-style lighting. A man wearing a white physician's lab coat stands to the left of a muscular man seated on an examination bed. The muscular man, dressed in a black t-shirt and shorts with visible arm tattoos, is wearing a specialized black and red laser hair growth helmet. He appears emotionally distressed, clutching the sides of his head while the doctor observes him with a concerned, professional expression. (2) The camera transitions to tight close-up shots of the muscular man's face, highlighting his deep furrowed brows and pained facial expressions. He gestures emphatically with his hands near his head, illustrating his internal struggle or frustration. The background features clinical cabinetry and medical lighting fixtures, providing a sharp, high-contrast environment that emphasizes the character's emotional state. (3) The doctor leans toward the patient, placing both hands firmly on his shoulders in a gesture of authoritative support. The patient looks away, his hands now balled into fists on his lap, indicating a stubborn or defiant posture. The visual focus remains on the interplay between the two characters' body language within the narrow confines of the treatment room. (4) The muscular man stands up from the medical bed, displaying his large physique as he moves toward the room's exit. The camera tracks his movement eyes-level as he walks through a modern hallway with wooden wall panels and warm recessed lighting. The doctor follows closely behind him, maintaining physical contact by placing a hand on the patient's shoulder. (5) The setting shifts to an outdoor urban street during the day under natural, slightly overcast daylight. The muscular man stands next to a grey PGO scooter, looking downcast. The doctor continues to engage him, pointing specifically at the laser hair growth helmet still resting on the man's head. The background consists of residential buildings and parked vehicles, adding a grounded, everyday context to their dramatic exchange. (6) In the final visual phase, the doctor reaches out and swaps the high-tech laser helmet for a standard motorcycle helmet. The patient is captured in a medium close-up, looking upward in confusion as a variety-style loading graphic appears over his head. The lighting is bright and natural, and the framing focuses on the patient's bewildered reaction to the switch.

By staging an intense argument between a muscular patient and his doctor about hair loss and the 'long-haired man' dream, it highlights the product's benefits in a memorable and humorous way.
